q: When do you feel closest to something greater than yourself?
a: In prayer, chanting or singing
In silence, with my eyes closed
When I'm doing my duty well
Honestly, I trust myself more than anything above me

q: If God sat in front of you right now, you would…
a: Fall at their feet and offer to serve
Hug them like an old friend
Ask every question I've ever had
Ask why they let so much go wrong

q: Someone humiliated you in public years ago. Today you…
a: Have forgiven it completely
Remember it, and I'm waiting for my moment
Answered it right then. It's settled
Still feel it burn. It shaped who I became

q: A vow you made now hurts innocent people. You…
a: Keep it. A vow is a vow
Break it. People matter more than promises
Find a clever way to keep it on paper and still help
Ask someone wiser what's right

q: Your closest friend asks you to join the wrong side. You…
a: Go with them. Loyalty is everything
Tell them plainly and leave
Stay close and try to change them from inside
Fight them if I have to

q: What do you want most from life?
a: Freedom from wanting anything
Power, and a name that lasts
Love, family and good times
To live rightly, whatever it costs

q: Which is worse?
a: Being a coward
Being a liar
Being ungrateful
Being a fool

q: Your greatest talent is ignored because of where you were born. You…
a: Prove them all wrong, at any cost
Keep practising alone, for its own sake
Give my loyalty to whoever does recognise me
Laugh. Titles mean nothing to me

q: A long life nobody remembers, or a short one the world never forgets?
a: Short and unforgettable
Long and quiet
Whichever my duty asks of me
Neither. I want to be free of the cycle

q: How do you win an argument?
a: With facts and scripture
With charm and a smile
With patience. I outlast them
I don't argue. I act

q: What is your relationship with desire?
a: I enjoy life fully. Desire is natural
I'm learning to watch it without obeying it
When I want something, I take it
I've given most of it up

q: Your family needs you, and so does the world. You choose…
a: Family, always
The world, and I'll carry the guilt
Whoever needs me more urgently
I leave it to God and follow the sign

q: What scares you most?
a: Losing the people I love
Being ordinary
Doing wrong without realising it
Nothing. Even death is a doorway

q: A powerful enemy offers you a deal that betrays someone small. You…
a: Refuse at once
Accept, then betray the enemy later
Accept. Power is power
Refuse and challenge them openly

q: When your anger rises, it is…
a: A storm that could level a city
Cold, quiet and patient
Something I hand over in prayer
Words I can't take back once they're said

q: Which teacher would you choose?
a: A strict master who tests me without mercy
A playful one who teaches through stories
Life itself. I learn by doing
A silent sage I simply sit beside

q: What would you sacrifice for the person you love most?
a: My own happiness, quietly, forever
My morals, if it came to that
My life, in battle
Nothing. Love shouldn't be a chain

q: How do you treat someone with less power than you?
a: Exactly as I'd treat a king
With kindness and gifts
Fairly, but they should know their place
It depends on whether they're useful to me

q: Which battle would you rather fight?
a: Against my own mind
Against an army, beside my brothers
Against injustice in my own home
I'd rather not fight at all

q: When you pray or make a wish, what do you ask for?
a: Nothing. I just say thank you
Strength to do my duty
Success, wealth, victory
Understanding

q: You discover a secret that could ruin someone you dislike. You…
a: Use it
Bury it forever
Tell them I know, so they change
Keep it for when I really need it

q: Your ideal home is…
a: A hut or a cave in the forest
A golden palace
A big house full of family and noise
Wherever my work takes me

q: How do you see fate?
a: It's written. I accept it with grace
I bend it with effort
It's a game, and I know the rules
It's karma. I reap what I sow

q: Someone you love makes a terrible mistake. You…
a: Defend them in public, scold them in private
Stand with the truth, even against them
Take the blame myself
Walk away

q: What do food, music and celebration mean to you?
a: I live for them
Pleasant, but I can drop them any time
I fast and keep strict discipline
I celebrate as a form of worship

q: You're given limitless power for one day. You…
a: Give it away. I don't trust myself with it
Set right every injustice I can
Make sure no one can ever threaten me again
Spend it on the people I love

q: Most of the time, your mind is…
a: Planning three moves ahead
Quiet
On fire with some goal
Full of someone I love

q: How do you change, if you change at all?
a: One crisis and I'm a different person
Slowly, through discipline
I don't. I am who I am
Through the people I love

q: In a team, your fatal flaw is…
a: I won't bend, even when I should
I trust the wrong people
I need to be the best one there
I play games no one else understands

q: Standing before a temple idol, you feel…
a: Love, like seeing family
Peace
Curious about what it symbolises
Not much. The divine is inside me

q: You've badly wronged someone. You…
a: Confess and accept any punishment
Quietly make it up to them
Justify it. They had it coming
Never forgive myself

q: A child asks you, "What is God?" You say…
a: "Love."
"The truth inside everything."
"Doing what's right."
"Be strong and you won't need one."

q: Your enemy falls before you, unarmed. You…
a: Spare them
Finish it. Mercy now costs lives later
Finish it. They never showed mercy
Make them an ally

q: Which of these is most like your inner world?
a: Still water
A river in flood
A chessboard
A temple lamp

q: Your biggest weakness is…
a: Pride
Attachment
Temper
Indulgence

q: A throne is yours by right, but your brother wants it. You…
a: Give it to him without a word
Take it. It's mine by right
Take it. He'd ruin the kingdom
Walk away from thrones entirely

q: How do you get what you want?
a: Hard work and patience
Penance and sheer willpower
Strategy and timing
I ask with love, and it usually comes

q: What would you most like to be known for?
a: My generosity
My courage
My wisdom
My devotion

q: When rules and love collide, which wins?
a: The rules
Love
Neither. I look for what's truly right
Whatever serves me

q: How do you take praise?
a: It embarrasses me
I enjoy it. I earned it
I pass it on to my teacher, or to God
I barely notice. I'm already on to the next thing

q: Right before the biggest moment of your life, you…
a: Doubt everything, ask someone I trust, then give it everything
Charge in without a second thought
Have planned for it for years
Feel calm. Whatever happens is fine

q: You're insulted in front of everyone you respect. You…
a: Demand justice, and don't rest until it's done
Stay silent and endure it
Plan my revenge quietly
Curse them on the spot

q: Which vow could you keep for your whole life?
a: Never to marry or rule, for my family's sake
Never to stop serving the one I love
Never to refuse anyone who asks me for something

q: You see something beautiful that isn't yours. You want…
a: To have it, whatever it takes
To admire it and move on
To win it fairly, in open competition
To create something even better myself

q: What kind of power do you admire most?
a: Mastery of knowledge and the arts
Raw strength
Moral authority
Being loved by everyone

q: Death comes for someone you love. You…
a: Follow it and argue, whatever it takes
Accept it. Everything that is born must end

q: You're offered every pleasure in the world if you stop asking one question. You…
a: Keep asking. The truth is worth more

q: Your parent asks you to do something terrible. You…
a: Obey. A parent's word is law

q: People keep telling you who you are. You…
a: Become exactly who I choose to be

q: You see someone powerful hurting someone weaker. You're old and tired. You…
a: Fight anyway
Run and find help

q: What do you do with a grudge?

Act on it at once, then forget it

q: What happens after death?
a: We're reborn according to our karma
We go back to the divine we loved

I'd rather focus on this life

q: A rule says you can't learn something because of who you are. You…
a: Learn it anyway, in secret
Lie my way in
Accept the rule
Fight to change the rule

q: Which would you carry into battle?
a: A bow
A mace
A veena

q: What could you never forgive?
a: Betrayal by family
Disrespect
Cruelty to the helpless
Nothing. I can forgive anything
